curatedNote: Everything in this file is hand-verified. Live price/volume/liquidity is fetched at runtime from Dexscreener and is never stored here.

canonical.name: Bittensor
canonical.bridge: Wormhole Native Token Transfers (NTT), issued through Sunrise

notThis.name: VoidAI Bridged wTAO
notThis.claim: A real third-party wrapper, not a scam — VoidAI's own Bittensor→Solana bridge, minted 1:1 against TAO locked on their bridge.
notThis.why: It is not the canonical mint and the book is effectively dead. You can get in and not get out.

notThis.name: listed as “Bittensor (TAO)” on some explorers
notThis.claim: Explorer metadata says Bittensor, on-chain data disagrees.
notThis.why: 6 decimals and a 191,930,177 supply. Bittensor's max supply is 21,000,000 and the canonical Solana mint uses 9 decimals. No DEX liquidity.

notThis.name: The Anthropic Order
notThis.claim: A pump.fun memecoin that took the TAO ticker.
notThis.why: Unrelated to Bittensor. Shows up in wallet and aggregator search because the ticker matches.

notThis.name: Bittensor (Token-2022)
notThis.claim: A Token-2022 mint that took the Bittensor name outright: 1,000,000,000 supply, metadata served from a third-party host.
notThis.why: Unrelated to Bittensor. No DEX pool at all, so there is nothing to sell it back into.

notThis.name: Win TAO
notThis.claim: A pump.fun memecoin trading on the TAO name.
notThis.why: Unrelated to Bittensor. It trades against the canonical mint rather than being it — a TAO-quoted memecoin, not TAO.

yield.note: TVL is fetched live from the DefiLlama public API and cached 10 minutes. Everything else here is curated prose.

routes.label: Native staking (dTAO)
routes.note: Subnet alpha pools on the base chain, reached with btcli or a Bittensor wallet. Essentially all of the money is here, and getting to it means leaving Solana completely.

routes.label: Bittensor EVM staking
routes.note: addStake(hotkey, amount, netuid) straight from an EVM transaction, reachable from Solana over LayerZero or Hyperlane. The figure is every DeFi dollar on that chain, not staked TAO — it is the room, and the room is empty.

routes.label: Tensorplex
routes.note: The only liquid staking protocol DefiLlama tracks on Bittensor.

routes.label: TaoFi
routes.note: The only DEX DefiLlama tracks on Bittensor EVM — its TVL is the whole chain's DeFi. Hyperlane lists both Solana and Subtensor, so the route in exists. The pattern works. The users are not there.

routes.label: wTAO bridge
routes.note: The Ethereum door, and the single-operator chokepoint described above. Real money, real structure.

routes.label: TAOlie
routes.note: Pitched one-click Bittensor mining on Solana back in 2024. Still listed, still zero. The precedent worth knowing about.

routes.label: Holding this wrapper
routes.note: No emissions, no dividends, no yield of any kind. It trades. That is the entire offer, and it is a perfectly good one — just not this one.

rewardModel.summary: StonkFun reward coins pay holders pro-rata in whatever token the coin is paired against. Paired against TAO, the dividend arrives as TAO.
rewardModel.v3: v3 launches: a transfer tax on every transfer, 1% or 3%, fixed permanently at launch.
rewardModel.legacy: Earlier launches: roughly 85% of the 4% pool trading fee.
rewardModel.payout: Fees accumulate until the pot is worth distributing, then split across holders. There is no fixed schedule.
